title: Undercurrents Surging, Return Journey Begins
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji raised his head toward the horizon, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes: "The Heavenly Eye... our chess game has just begun."

text.content: The moment Chen Ji tucked the Tianji Record into his chest, a piercing sword intent came slashing through the air from the direction of Tianqing Sect — Su Qingyao, she had finally caught up. That sword intent carried the unique cold malevolence of an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, like a drawn frost blade aimed directly at Chen Ji's throat. The surrounding air instantly solidified, grass and trees bowing silently as if even heaven and earth were making way for this sword intent.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao stood suspended in mid-air, her black hair dancing in the wind, her phoenix eyes carrying intertwined killing intent and doubt. "What exactly did you obtain in that secret realm? Why would all the elders of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion tremble at this moment?" Her voice was cold as ice, yet hiding an imperceptible urgency.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, still wearing that harmless, cowardly expression, like a fawn cornered by a fierce beast. He instinctively retreated half a step, his shoulders trembling slightly, his voice thin as a mosquito's buzz: "Su... Senior Sister Su, this humble one only wandered into the secret realm by accident, I didn't gain anything..." Despite his words, beneath his lowered eyelids, his pupils were terrifyingly cold, taking in Su Qingyao's position, the trajectory of her sword intent, and the surrounding terrain.

dialogue.content: "Is that so?" Su Qingyaosneered一声，剑意陡然拔高三分，「那你怀中之物，为何能引动天机阁的镇宗之宝异动？陈机，你当我是三岁孩童吗！」她向前逼近一步，周身spiritual energy如潮水般涌动，将陈机周遭退路尽数封死，「最后一次机会，说实话。」

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao pressed closer step by step, her sword intent like thorns at his back. Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record in his chest grow slightly warm, the pressing sense of a three-month countdown flooding his heart. It was time to make a choice —

choices.text: Pretending to be foolish, playing the pitiful card, retreating to advance
choices.description: Continue maintaining the waste persona, using the most humble posture to dissolve Su Qingyao's suspicion, waiting for the opportunity to scheme in the shadows.
choices.visible_cost: Enduring the humiliation of sword intent pressure
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao temporarily lowers her guard, gaining freedom of action
choices.risk_hint: If seen through, will completely lose trust

text.content: Chen Ji's legs went soft and he "thumped" to the ground, trembling like a sieve, his eye sockets instantly reddening, tears flowing unbidden: "Sister, spare my life! This humble one really doesn't know anything! That thing... that thing flew into my chest by itself, I couldn't throw it away..." He kowtowed while crying, his forehead striking the gravel and quickly drawing blood.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's sword intent faltered for a moment. She looked at Chen Ji's pitiful appearance, her brow furrowed. This waste... crying so genuinely, it didn't seem fake. But how to explain the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's reaction? She hesitated briefly, retracting her sword intent by three parts, and said coldly: "Get up. What a sorry spectacle, crying and wailing." Though her tone was harsh, the killing intent in her eyes had diminished.

choices.text: Scheming in the shadows, revealing trump cards
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to show Su Qingyao a prophecy only she could understand, trading shock for a brief strategic respite.
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao is shocked by the prophecy, temporarily reaching cooperation
choices.risk_hint: Consumes precious Heavenly Fate points, and exposes part of abilities

text.content: Chen Ji's lowered head slowly rose, a meaningful curve appearing at the corner of his mouth. He no longer trembled, his eyes flickering with a chilling depth that made one's heart skip. Su Qingyao's heart lurched — this gaze, entirely different from that waste servant disciple. Chen Ji took out the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest, golden runes flowing as it sketched a blurry image in the air: "Senior Sister Su, the truth you wish to see... is this?"

dialogue.content: In the image, Su Qingyao saw a fact that made her entire body go cold — three months later, the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate would collapse, her own blood staining the azure peaks, and the mastermind was someone she revered most. Her face instantly turned ashen, the hand gripping her sword trembled violently: "This... is this real?" Chen Ji returned the fragment to his chest, saying calmly: "Believe it or not, that's your choice."

choices.text: Fierce confrontation, breaking the situation with force
choices.description: No longer concealing, revealing true strength, letting Su Qingyao realize she is no match for him at all.
choices.visible_cost: Completely exposing strength, waste persona crumbles
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao is forced to retreat, gaining absolute dominance
choices.risk_hint: Attracts more forces' attention, multi-front pressure drastically increases

text.content: Chen Ji chuckled lightly, his form flickering as he vanished before Su Qingyao's eyes. In the next instant, a pressure sufficient to make her soul tremble came surging from all directions. Her sword intent before this pressure was like fireflies against the bright moon, utterly unworthy. "Senior Sister Su," Chen Ji's voice sounded from behind her, ice-cold yet carrying a hint of playfulness, "your sword is very slow."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao spun around sharply, sword raised before her, only to see Chen Ji standing with hands clasped behind his back, those eyes holding not a trace of killing intent, only an abyss-like calm. Her back was soaked in cold sweat — that moment, she truly and thoroughly felt death. "Who... who exactly are you?" Her voice trembled for the first time.

text.content: Just as the atmosphere grew razor-sharp, several escape lights suddenly blazed across the distant horizon. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly — they came fast. He squinted and looked out to see three figures arriving through the air, each radiating powerful auras, actually forces from three different factions. On the left were elite disciples of Xuanwu Sect, on the right were swordsmen from the Ten Thousand Swords Gate, and that cold aura directly ahead... was someone from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. The return from the secret realm had become a battlefield for various forces to maneuver.

dialogue.content: A wisp of black mist condensed beside Chen Ji, and Ye Qing's form emerged from within. She glanced at Su Qingyao, a mocking smile curling at her lips: "Oh, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect chasing after her own servant disciple? What grand authority." She leaned close to Chen Ji's ear, lowering her voice, "Three groups outside, none of them pushovers. The aura of your Tianji Record... they've sensed it."

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but his mind raced rapidly. Three forces arriving together, the timing impeccable — clearly someone deliberately leaked the information. He probed the Tianji Record with his divine sense, and a cold prompt surfaced: "Three-month countdown begins. Heavenly Fate consumption warning: 99 points remaining. Suggestion: Reduce prophetic usage, prioritize key node arrangements." Meanwhile, a blurry symbol flashed through his Mental Sea — a totem he had never seen before, emanating an ancient and mysterious aura.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. That symbol... wasn't the power of the Tianji Record itself, but guidance from an external source. He suddenly remembered what Mo Xiansheng had said: "When you see that eye, that is when you find me." Could this be... a signal left by that mysterious helper? The symbol's meaning was like viewing flowers through fog, half-hidden, seemingly speaking of some secret about the true weakness of the Heavenly Eye.

text.content: "Chen Ji, you brat!" A resonant voice came from the direction of Xuanwu Sect — it was Han Lie. He held a massive sword, looking down at Chen Ji from above with utter contempt in his eyes. "Didn't expect this waste to survive coming out of the secret realm. Fine, saves this young lord the trouble of hunting you down — hand over what you got from that secret realm, and this young lord will spare your worthless dog life!" Behind him, dozens of Xuanwu Sect disciples burst into laughter, not regarding Chen Ji as worth their attention at all.

choice.prompt: Three forces watched with hungry eyes, Han Lie humiliating him publicly. Faced with such a situation, how should Chen Ji break the deadlock?

choices.text: Using force to strike force, creating chaos
choices.description: Exploit the conflicts of interest among the three forces, letting them check each other while seizing the chance to slip away.
choices.visible_reward: Forces check each other, successfully escape while planting discord
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, will offend all three forces simultaneously

text.content: A slight smile appeared at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth as he suddenly burst out laughing before everyone. His laughter was clear and mocking, instantly drowning out Han Lie's arrogance. "Young Lord Han, what grand authority," he said slowly, "but I'm curious — people from Ten Thousand Swords Gate and the Holy Sect are also here. Will you deal with me first, or them?" At these words, all three groups changed expression simultaneously, and as they exchanged glances, killing intent surged.

dialogue.content: A trace of appreciation flickered in Ye Qing's eyes. She swept her sleeve, and the Demonic Path mist surged magnificently, shrouding Chen Ji completely. Meanwhile, as Chen Ji had anticipated, the three forces truly began probing and checking each other. Han Lie's face turned livid, the Ten Thousand Swords Gate swordsmen responded with cold smiles, while that Holy Sect figure阴森地扫视着众人。「走。」陈机whispered道，趁乱遁入迷雾之中。

choices.text: Slapping them in the face on the spot, overwhelming with strength
choices.description: Before everyone, cleanly and decisively defeat Han Lie, using absolute strength to intimidate the rabble.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie loses all face, three forces dare not act rashly
choices.risk_hint: After exposing strength, will become the target of all

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward slowly, each step carrying suffocating pressure. His gaze changed, no longer that cringing waste servant disciple, but a chess master looking down on the world. "Han Lie," he said softly, "do you know why I've always let you off?" Before his words even finished, his form flickered, and a brilliant sword glow condensed in his palm — that was a strike fused with the power of the Tianji Record, sufficient to cleave mountains and shatter rocks.

dialogue.content: Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply, wanting to block but already too late. The sword glow pierced through his shoulder, blood scattering as诡异的spiritual energy侵入他体内，将他的meridians搅得乱七八糟。他惨叫着跌落在地，堂堂玄武宗第一天才，竟连一招都接不下。「你……你……」韩烈满脸不可置信，「你怎么可能……」陈机居高临下地看着他：「trash？韩少主，你这话，我took note of this。」

text.content: Ye Qing施展魔道迷雾，将三方势力隔绝在视野之外，同时遮掩天机录的气息。「你倒是会借力，」她斜睨着陈机，「不过三方势力不会善罢甘休。接下来你打算怎么办？」陈机负手而立，望着迷雾外若隐若现的遁光：「三个月……够了。」他闭上眼，那个mysterious的符号再次浮现，这一次，他看清了更多细节——那是一只闭合的眼睛，眼睑上刻满了密密麻麻的符文。

dialogue.content: The first page of the Tianji Record glowed faintly, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted out, his voice aged and profound: "That eye... is the life point of the 'Heavenly Eye.' It can see through past and future, yet has one fatal blind spot — when it actively observes a target, it cannot perceive itself. Lad, you've finally touched the edge of the truth." Mo Xiansheng's figure gradually dissipated, leaving behind one profound words: "The road ahead... you must walk alone."

text.content: Su Qingyao stood rooted to the spot, gazing at the direction where Chen Ji disappeared for a long while without speaking. In that instant, she had clearly seen that symbol — that closed eye, identical to the 'Heavenly Eye' life point totem recorded in the ancient texts of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion. Could it be... this waste servant disciple she had been pursuing actually held the key to opposing the Heavenly Eye? She gripped her long sword tightly, complex light flickering in her eyes: "Chen Ji... who exactly are you?"

choice.prompt: The mysterious symbol has revealed the Heavenly Eye's weakness, and Chen Ji has obtained crucial information. Under the pressure of a three-month countdown, he needs to make the next deployment.

choices.text: Contact the Demonic Path, consolidate allies
choices.description: Deepen cooperation with Ye Qing, leverage the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path's strength against the three major sects, while searching for clues about his sister Chen Nian.
choices.visible_cost: Become more deeply entangled with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Gain support from Demonic Path resources, reduce hostility from righteous forces
choices.risk_hint: There are factional disputes within the Demonic Path, may bring trouble upon oneself

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stopped in her tracks, looking back at Chen Ji with some surprise in her eyes: "You want to cooperate with me?" Shescoffed一声，「你一个天青宗的trash杂役，和魔道圣女合作？这传出去，三大宗门怕是要把你生吞活剥了。」陈机calm地与她对视：「三个月后，天道之眼将降下大劫。届时，正邪之分……还有意义吗？」夜清愣了一瞬，随即放声大笑：「有意思，真有意思。」

choices.description: Return to Tianqing Sect, using the waste persona as cover, gradually eliminate Ling Yuan's minions, dismantle the old Sect Master's conspiracy.
choices.visible_reward: Establish a secret force within Tianqing Sect, laying groundwork for the final showdown
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is wily and experienced, any slip could lead to exposure

text.content: Chen Ji decided to temporarily return to Tianqing Sect. On the surface, he remained that cringing waste servant disciple, sweeping floors, carrying water, being bullied by fellow disciples; but secretly, he began his layout. Ling Yuan... that old fox, he had seen through him long ago. Chen Ji clenched his fist, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes. Since you want the Tianji Record, then I'll give it to you — give you a "Tianji Record"足以让你万劫不复的。

Night fell. Chen Ji and Ye Qing stood atop a high peak, overlooking the vast land below. In the distance, Tianqing Sect glowed brightly, Xuanwu Sect bristled with killing intent, while the direction of the Holy Sect of Demonic Path was shrouded in eerie black mist. The three-month countdown had begun, every moment slipping away. Chen Ji took out the Tianji Record from his chest, golden runes shining in the darkness, illuminating those deep eyes like an abyss. The Heavenly Eye's weakness was now known, next... it was time to lay out the pieces.

"The Heavenly Eye..." Chen Ji murmured, his fingertips gently brushing the cover of the Tianji Record. His gaze pierced through layers of mist, as if seeing that高高在上、俯瞰众生的眼睛。三个月，够吗？他不知道。但有一件事他很清楚——这场棋局，从他得到天机录的那一刻起，就已经没有退路了。不是他死，就是天道之眼灭。

A gust of night wind blew by, carrying a faint, distant sigh. Chen Ji looked up sharply but saw nothing. Only the symbol of that closed eye flashed once more in his Mental Sea, as if reminding him — you are not alone. The identity of that mysterious helper remains a mystery; but what can be confirmed is that someone is watching him from the shadows, waiting for him to take that crucial step.

Three months later, Tianqing Sect Outer Court Training Grounds. The morning bell rang, and servant disciples gradually woke, beginning their new day's labor. Chen Ji shouldered his broom, blending into the crowd, still wearing that cringing expression. His gaze swept across the surroundings, memorizing every possible spy and every hidden passage. On the surface, he was a waste struggling to survive at the very bottom; but unbeknownst to anyone, in his heart he carried — the world-shaking grand chess game of how to destroy an enormous entity like the Heavenly Eye.

Just then, a familiar figure walked over from a distance — Su Qingyao. Her gaze swept across the crowd of servant disciples, finally fixing on Chen Ji. Through the bustling tide of people, their eyes met. Chen Ji slightly lowered his head, hunched his shoulders, once again becoming that timid waste. But at the corner of his lips, an almost imperceptible curve appeared. Tianqing Sect's winds and clouds were about to surge once more. And he, Chen Ji, was already蓄势待发。Chen Ji raised his head toward the horizon, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes: "The Heavenly Eye... our chess game has just begun."
